newsitem.title: USA: Xeikon says Q1 hurt by currency exchange.
newsitem.headline: Xeikon says Q1 hurt by currency exchange.

text.p: Xeikon NV said Wednesday results for the first quarter were affected by appreciation in the value of the U.S. dollar versus the Belgian franc, and by delayed purchasing decisions.
The company said the U.S. dollar has appreciated an average of 13 percent versus the Belgian franc for the first quarter, compared to the same period a year ago.
The company said revenues for the quarter were hurt by market anticipation of new products that are expected to be introduced at a major trade show in June.
The company also said purchase decisions in North America were delayed because of transition issues in its distribution channel.
The company reported pro forma losses per share of $0.14, compared to a profit of $0.01 per share for the same period a year ago.
